from object_detector_tool import object_detector_tool

def count_tall_building_with_flat_top(image_path, labels=None, threshold=0.35, model_size="tiny"):
    # Load the image
    image = object_detector_tool(image_path)

    # Define object labels
    object_labels = [
        *object_detector_tool(labels=labels, threshold=threshold, model_size=model_size),
        "Lackawanna Tower"
    ]
    object_boxes = [bbox for _, _, bbox in image]
    count = sum([1 for label in object_labels if label in object_boxes])

    return count

final_result = count_tall_building_with_flat_top("/home/stud/wxie/BLINK_Dataset/Counting/val/images/val_Counting_10_image_1.jpg")
print(final_result)
</command>
